ai_summary.text:
インテリジェント ウェイブは金融機関向けセキュリティ・不正検知システムの専門企業。クレジットカードの不正利用検知、ネットバンキングのセキュリティ監視、サイバーセキュリティ製品を金融機関に提供している。

売上156億円（前年比+7.4%）、営業利益18億円（営業利益率11.9%）、純利益13億円と増収増益。金融セキュリティの専門領域で12%近い営業利益率を達成しており、不正検知需要の拡大が業績を押し上げた。ROE14.2%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率50.7%、財務健全性スコア93点。営業CF43億円、FCF27億円と安定したキャッシュ創出。EPS52円に対しPER21.6倍、配当35円で配当性向は約68%。キャッシュレス決済の普及に伴う不正検知需要の構造的拡大と、サイバー攻撃の高度化がセキュリティ投資を後押ししている。なお、EPS51.5円、PER21.6倍、1株当たり配当金35.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Intelligent Wave is a specialized company providing security and fraud detection systems for financial institutions. They provide credit card fraud detection, internet banking security monitoring, and cybersecurity products to financial institutions.  Sales were 15.6 billion yen (up 7.4% year-on-year), operating profit was 1.8 billion yen (operating profit margin of 11.9%), and net profit was 1.3 billion yen, resulting in increased revenue and profit. They achieved an operating profit margin of nearly 12% in the specialized area of financial security, with the expansion of fraud detection demand boosting earnings. High capital efficiency with ROE of 14.2%.  Equity ratio of 50.7%, financial soundness score of 93 points. Stable cash generation with operating CF of 4.3 billion yen and FCF of 2.7 billion yen. PER is 21.6 times for EPS of 52 yen, dividend is 35 yen, and the dividend payout ratio is approximately 68%. Structural expansion of fraud detection demand accompanying the spread of cashless payments and the sophistication of cyberattacks are driving security investment. Additionally, at the levels of EPS 51.5 yen, PER 21.6 times, and dividend per share of 35.0 yen, management is promoting both shareholder returns and corporate value improvement.
